title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: Spyglass, our comprehensive new tool, is now generally available, bringing powerful new capabilities to your fingertips.

title: Take Control: Enhanced File Management is Here!
summary: Now you can effortlessly add, organize, and customize the appearance of all your images and documents directly within the editor for a truly tailored content creation experience.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a brand-new public roadmap page, offering complete transparency into our recently shipped features, what's next, and our exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and seamlessly draggable for intuitive task management.

title: Enhanced Collaborative Editing
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with our newly improved editor, designed to make collaborating with others effortless and intuitive.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Shared Content Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and utilize all content shared with you, now fully integrated into search and your network's constellation view, making collaboration smoother and more impactful.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Native Language
summary: We are thrilled to bring Noeko to a global audience by adding comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko's codebase is now open source, inviting you to contribute directly, gain maximum control, and share in the transparent evolution of our project.

title: Unlock Deeper Insights in Your Constellation View
summary: Experience a more dynamic and insightful Constellation View with powerful new filters, enabling you to effortlessly explore your knowledge base by tags, timeframes, and shared content.

title: Unlock Deeper Insights with Advanced Search & Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly narrow down your knowledge with powerful new filters and save your custom searches for instant access to precisely what you need.

title: Smarter Content Connections
summary: Transform your notes into a seamlessly connected and interactive workspace with flexible new ways to view and engage with linked information.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosted Freedom and Premium Power
summary: Soon, you can host Noeko on your own infrastructure or select from new flexible plans designed to empower your team with enhanced capabilities and greater control.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Refinements
summary: We're refreshing our current themes and introducing a diverse selection of beautiful new options to personalize your experience.

title: Personalized Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your homepage experience by ensuring that all time-based greetings accurately reflect the current time of day, offering a more precise and personalized welcome.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content with new direct actions, allowing you to unapply tags or delete items without leaving the tag view.

title: Unlock More Information Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate diverse information sources, including web pages, videos, and text files, to centralize all your valuable content and insights.
